params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the named range or named formula to remove

params.name: scope
params.description: Target scope (default = current sheet); may also be a sheet index (counting begins at 0)

sentinelValues.meaning: Remove the name from the current sheet's scope.
Remove the name from the workbook-level scope.

overloads.semanticRole: The VP REMOVE NAME command removes the named range or named formula passed in the name parameter in the defined scope .

constraints: An error is returned if vpAreaName does not designate an existing 4D View Pro area.
